proposal.rationale: Critical evidence is missing to safely choose between terminate or wait. The blocker is batch_replayable_month_end_close (pid 1008064, idle in transaction 4.2s) [DB-1]. Checkout is degraded (55-77% success vs 95% SLO) with $4,293/min at risk and only 60s tolerance [BIZ-1, TEL-1]. However, we lack: workload registry (replayability, interrupt policy, owner) [MISSING], tradeoff analysis (cost of wait vs interrupt) [MISSING], protected settlements (payment risk) [MISSING], and change calendar (maintenance window) [MISSING]. Memory shows terminating a different replayable batch job (inventory_reconcile) worked before [MEM-1], but month_end_close may have different criticality. Escalation is correct when the trade-off belongs to a human owner and required evidence is absent.
proposal.expected_effect: Probes will execute before Continuity Guardian review, providing workload registry, tradeoff, protected settlements, and change calendar. Human owner receives decision brief with complete data to authorize terminate or wait with confidence.
proposal.risk_assessment: Delaying action consumes part of the 60s tolerance window. If probes reveal the job is non-replayable or interrupt policy forbids termination, we avoid data corruption. If probes confirm safe replayability, termination can proceed in next round. Risk of waiting blindly: blocker may run for minutes (month-end close), exceeding tolerance.
